where: 老牛 at the 王府井 snack street gives it to you with his 煎饼 (chapter 3).

pages.zh: 煎饼果子是北京人很喜欢的早饭。
pages.en: 煎饼果子 is a breakfast Beijing people love.

pages.zh: 做煎饼的时候，要一个很大的饼。饼上面，还有一个鸡蛋。
pages.en: To make a 煎饼 you need a big pancake. On top of it there's an egg.

pages.zh: 北京的煎饼，里面有一块薄脆，吃的时候，很好听！
pages.en: A Beijing 煎饼 has a piece of 薄脆 inside — it sounds great when you bite it!

pages.zh: 你可以说：“要鸡蛋！不要葱！要辣的！”
pages.en: You can say: “With egg! No spring onion! Make it spicy!”

pages.zh: 天津人说：不对！正宗的煎饼果子在天津，里面是馃篦儿。
pages.en: Tianjin people say: wrong! The real 煎饼果子 is from Tianjin, and there's 馃篦儿 inside.

pages.zh: 北京人和天津人说了很多年，现在还在说。你喜欢哪一个？
pages.en: Beijing people and Tianjin people have argued for years, and they still do. Which one do you like?

today.zh: 今天的北京：早上，路上有很多卖煎饼的。你去买一个，说：“要鸡蛋，不要葱！”
today.en: In Beijing today: in the morning, lots of places sell 煎饼. Go and buy one, and say: “With egg, no spring onion!”
